measurement.tolerance_rule: max_regression_delta = 2 x the largest per-metric sample standard deviation of the run means, rounded up to 0.01 (minimum 0.01); metrics = mean of the run means
measurement.notes: Three sequential `lattice-rag eval --output` runs on unchanged code (fix/audit-spec-issue-2 at faece2c plus ticket-16, before ticket-19), Gold Set v2 (30 queries), ephemeral DB, macOS, local ONNX models. No pipeline or judge errors; Groq returned 429 on 1/4/2 queries per run and those answers came from the Gemini fallback, so that noise is inside the measurement. faithfulness sd 0.0215 is the widest: 2 x 0.0215 = 0.043, rounded up to 0.05. Per-run passed queries 22/25/20. Floor violations: Noul contradiction vetoes (faithfulness 0.0) on long_context queries eval_20, eval_28 (run 1), eval_28, eval_29 (run 3); run 2 had none.
